claims.title: Conspicuous Consumption Proves Capitalism Is Pure Waste
claims.socialistClaimText: Advertising, luxury brands, and status goods prove capitalism produces wasteful consumption for elite status rather than real human needs — just as Veblen described.
claims.executiveSummary: Veblen's Theory of the Leisure Class is a serious steelman: humans do compete via status goods. But markets also expand access to status-adjacent goods over time (phones, cars, fashion), lower real prices of basics, and fund innovation that was once luxury. Status competition exists under socialism too — party privileges, dachas, nomenklatura goods — without the productivity gains of open competition.
evidenceBullets: Veblen (1899) correctly observed status emulation; the text is public domain and worth reading in full in the app library.
BLS / CPI long series: real prices of apparel, consumer electronics, and many durables fell for decades while quality rose — status goods democratize.
Soviet and Eastern Bloc archives document hierarchical privilege goods (special stores, dachas) without competitive consumer markets.
Markets reallocate production when status tastes shift; central plans historically misallocated toward prestige projects (steel, missiles) over consumer welfare.

claims.title: Jack London's Iron Heel Shows Capitalism Ends in Fascist Oligarchy
claims.socialistClaimText: London's Iron Heel predicted that capital would crush labor with a military oligarchy — so revolution is necessary self-defense.
claims.executiveSummary: The Iron Heel is powerful revolutionary fiction, not a forecast model. Open market democracies expanded suffrage, union rights, real wages, and middle classes after 1908 rather than converging on a permanent Iron Heel. Actual 20th-century totalitarian oligarchies arose most lethally under Marxist-Leninist one-party states that banned independent unions and capital markets.
evidenceBullets: London (1908) is PD fiction worth steelmanning; it is not empirical political economy.
U.S./UK real wages and consumer durables access rose dramatically across the 20th century under mixed market systems.
Independent trade unions were crushed in USSR, Maoist China, and other socialist states — the opposite of worker empowerment.
Polyarchy and electoral turnover in market democracies constrain permanent military-capital oligarchy better than vanguard parties did.

claims.title: The Jungle Proves Unregulated Capitalism Is Inherently Cruel
claims.socialistClaimText: Sinclair's Jungle proves free markets inevitably produce meatpacking horrors, immigrant exploitation, and filth — so only socialism or heavy socialization can protect workers and consumers.
claims.executiveSummary: The Jungle correctly exposed packinghouse abuses and helped spur food safety law — a classic market-failure-plus-reform story. It does not prove socialist ownership is required. Competitive markets, liability, unions, and targeted regulation raised food safety and wages without abolishing private packing firms. Socialist meat systems later produced their own shortages, black markets, and quality failures.
evidenceBullets: Sinclair (1906) is PD and essential progressive-era steelman reading in the library.
U.S. Pure Food and Drug Act / Meat Inspection Act (1906) show democratic reform path without nationalizing the industry.
Long-run foodborne illness and sanitation improvements tracked inspection, refrigeration, logistics, and competition — not Gosplan.
Sinclair himself later complained readers focused on food safety over his socialist conversion message — the public chose reform capitalism.

claims.title: The Paris Commune Is the Model for Real Democracy
claims.socialistClaimText: Marx's Civil War in France shows the Paris Commune as true democracy of the working class — the model we should revive instead of bourgeois parliaments.
claims.executiveSummary: Marx's Civil War in France is the primary steelman for Commune-style 'smash the state' democracy. Historically the 1871 Commune was short-lived, internally factional, and followed by repression; 20th-century regimes that claimed Commune lineage built one-party states with secret police, not rotating worker councils with exit rights. Liberal constitutional democracy with property, speech, and multiparty competition has a stronger peace and prosperity record.
evidenceBullets: Marx's own Civil War in France is PD via MIA and bundled in the library for full steelman reading.
Lenin later cited Commune lessons to justify dictatorship of the proletariat — not multiparty liberalism.
Empirical Polity/V-Dem style democracy measures favor open contestation and civil liberties over single-class dictatorship models.
Exit, voice, and property rights allow peaceful disagreement; Commune-style dual power historically escalates to civil war.

claims.title: Reform Is Betrayal — Only Revolution Delivers Socialism
claims.socialistClaimText: Rosa Luxemburg proved Bernstein-style reformism betrays the working class; democratic socialism that keeps markets is fake.
claims.executiveSummary: Luxemburg's Reform or Revolution is the classic revolutionary steelman against gradualism. Yet the Nordic and broader social-democratic record shows high living standards via markets plus welfare, not via Luxemburgist seizure of production. Revolutionary paths that rejected reformism produced famine, secret police, and stagnation far more often than worker emancipation.
evidenceBullets: Luxemburg (1900) is PD and bundled for steelman reading against democratic-socialist gradualism.
Nordic economies rank high on economic freedom and private ownership of capital despite large welfare states.
Revolutionary socialist states that followed anti-reform orthodoxy (USSR, Maoist China, Cambodia) produced mass deaths and low consumption.
Bernstein's evolutionary path is closer to what successful high-trust welfare states actually did — trade, property, democracy.

claims.title: A Vanguard Party Is Necessary to Lead the Workers
claims.socialistClaimText: Lenin's Left-Wing Communism and What Is to Be Done show workers need a professional revolutionary party; spontaneous movements fail.
claims.executiveSummary: Lenin's vanguard theory is the operational steelman for centralized revolutionary organization. In practice vanguard parties substituted themselves for the working class, banned rival parties and independent unions, and built police states. Liberal democracies allow parties, unions, and NGOs to compete without a single organizational monopoly on 'class interest'.
evidenceBullets: Lenin's Left-Wing Communism is PD and now bundled for tactical steelman reading.
One-party states claiming proletarian representation suppressed strikes and free unions (USSR 1920s–80s; PRC).
Competitive elections and free association let workers choose representation without a permanent vanguard monopoly.
Public choice: professional revolutionaries have their own power incentives once state violence is monopolized.

claims.title: Scientific Experts Can Plan a Modern Utopia
claims.socialistClaimText: H. G. Wells showed that trained administrators and science can redesign society rationally — markets are primitive trial-and-error.
claims.executiveSummary: Wells's Modern Utopia and New Worlds for Old are eloquent technocratic steelmans. Mises/Hayek calculation and knowledge problems remain: experts lack the price signals and local knowledge needed to allocate scarce capital. 20th-century planning experiments that claimed scientific administration produced shortages, black markets, and political privilege — not Wellsian harmony.
evidenceBullets: Wells PD texts are bundled for steelman reading of constructive/Fabian socialism.
Mises (1920) and Hayek (1945) knowledge problem: dispersed local knowledge is not centralizable into a single plan.
Gosplan, Great Leap targets, and Venezuelan price controls illustrate scientific-looking plans failing consumer coordination.
Market prices aggregate trade-offs continuous planning committees cannot simulate without property and exchange.

claims.title: Class Solidarity Is a Fiction — Only Egoism Is Real
claims.socialistClaimText: Some radicals argue Stirner proved collective class ideals are spooks; only the unique ego matters — so Marxist solidarity is fraudulent.
claims.executiveSummary: Stirner's Ego and His Own is the radical individualist steelman Marx hated. It usefully attacks sacred collective abstractions, but pure egoism is not a complete social theory of cooperation. Markets and voluntary associations harness self-interest without requiring a unified proletarian will or a vanguard to invent one.
evidenceBullets: Stirner PD text is bundled; Marx/Engels spent a large section of German Ideology attacking him.
Market exchange is mutual advantage among egos — no mystical class subject required.
Collective action problems (Olson) show 'class interest' does not automatically produce class action.
Constitutional liberty protects the unique individual against both capital cartels and party collectives.
